summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing that its previously disclosed delisting from Euronext Amsterdam, first announced 13 August 2026, became effective 11 September 2026, with trading in its ordinary shares on that exchange ceasing the same day. No price, stake or consideration is involved. Ferrovial remains listed on the Spanish Stock Exchanges and Nasdaq Global Select Market, and retains Dutch incorporation and governance. Watch for index/float effects, residual Amsterdam liquidity migration and any future listing-structure changes; no arbitrage angle exists beyond potential dual-listing spread dislocations.
